evidence_quotes: Beroep tegen projectplan op grond van de Waterwet niet-ontvankelijk.
rationale: The decision concerns an appeal (ruled inadmissible) against a project plan adopted pursuant to the Dutch Water Act (projectplan op grond van de Waterwet, Art. 5.4 Waterwet), which governs the construction or modification of water management works (waterstaatswerken) by a water authority. It is substantively a systemic water governance dispute rather than a household connection or informal settlement dispute.
